_readme: Copy this file to auth-config.json (same folder) and fill in real values — that file is gitignored, never commit real credentials. Generate a passwordHash on the server with: php -r "echo password_hash('your-password-here', PASSWORD_DEFAULT), PHP_EOL;" — role is 'admin' or 'editor' (defaults to 'editor' if omitted). Once at least one admin account exists, the rest can be managed from the admin page itself (Manage Users).
